verdict.rationale: Tavily ships an official MCP server that exposes tavily-search and tavily-extract as ready-made tools for Cursor, Claude Desktop, and any MCP client. It also provides an agent-setup SKILL.md and LLM-oriented helpers such as get_search_context and qna_search, so agents can consume it directly via tool calls. However, the evidence shows no published function-calling schemas (the OpenAPI probe returned 404) and no named agent-framework integrations. missing for 10: documented function-calling/JSON tool schemas, first-party agent-framework integrations (e.g. LangChain/LlamaIndex-style), MCP coverage beyond search/extract, independent hands-on corroboration
